_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With zero ±2-point moves in 73 consecutive windows, the coil owns the base rate — HOLD is the honest statistical call until the named breakers (DXY <99, funding >0.01%, negative exchange netflow) actually fire.
next_move.brains_agree: Both brains lean UP toward Hope, but neither claims the breaker has triggered yet — the analyst's confirmed_if conditions are still pending, so the consensus honors the coil.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.01% with DXY breaking below 99.00 and exchange netflow turning negative (outflows)
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with DXY reclaiming 100.50 and BTC funding flipping negative — risk-off contagion kills the recovery setup
